events.title: Lisa Su named AMD CEO
events.summary: AMD appointed Lisa Su president and CEO on October 8, 2014 — tasking her with turning around the struggling chipmaker.
events.about: Su's Zen architecture and Epyc server CPUs restored AMD as a credible Intel competitor and made the company a key alternative in data centers and gaming. She later became one of the most visible [semiconductor] executives in the AI era.

narrative.whyChosen: Su's leadership revived AMD from near-irrelevance to a major Intel and NVIDIA rival.
narrative.whyImportant: Competition in CPUs and GPUs matters for cloud pricing and AI hardware diversity.
narrative.problemSolved: AMD had lost server and desktop share and needed a product-led turnaround.

events.title: Safari 8 released
events.summary: Apple released Safari 8 on October 16, 2014 with [OS] X Yosemite — adding WebGL improvements, Tab View, and DuckDuckGo as a search option.
events.about: Safari 8 refined the Yosemite design language with translucent [UI] and tighter iCloud integration. WebGL and IndexedDB improvements kept pace with Chrome for casual gaming and offline apps on Mac.

narrative.whyChosen: Safari 8 paired with Yosemite's visual redesign and continuity features.
narrative.whyImportant: Tab View and iCloud tabs deepened cross-device browsing on Apple hardware.
narrative.problemSolved: Mac users wanted Safari to feel as modern as the redesigned [OS] X Yosemite.

events.title: Samsung Galaxy Note 4 released
events.summary: Samsung released the Samsung Galaxy Note 4 — QHD display and improved S Pen latency for note-taking apps.
events.about: The Galaxy Note targeted stylus power users on [Android]. Qhd display and improved s pen latency for note-taking apps. Note apps and split-screen [Android] development often targeted this hardware class.

narrative.whyChosen: The Samsung Galaxy Note 4 advanced Samsung's stylus phablet line.
narrative.whyImportant: Galaxy Note hardware defined large-screen [Android] productivity for years.
narrative.problemSolved: [Android] lacked a premium large-screen stylus flagship for note-taking workflows.
